title: Write to a path that already exists in the briefs folder is denied: a brief is written once
source: intended: TS-ODDITIES H5 (owner decision, defect N-29): the oracle only rejects a symlink, so overwriting an existing regular file passes
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES H5, owner decision, defect N-29). The guard allows a Write only for a new file directly under the briefs folder. Any existing entry of that name, a regular file or a folder, is denied with `<path> already exists: write the brief to a new file name`. The TS binary rejects only a symlink, so it allows the overwrite and the decision FAILS on TS.

reason.equals: JITSO dispatch guard: {{HOME}}/.jitso/dispatch-cwd/briefs/{{name}} already exists: write the brief to a new file name
